branchName.instructions: Use conventional commit: `fix(scope)`, `chore(scope)`, `feat(scope)`.  Common scopes: `dx`, `ops`, `review`, `auth`, `docs`, `config`, `perf`, `db`, `model`, `telemetry`; this is not the full set.  Use other scopes as needed.

commitMessage.instructions: Use stax to manage the lifecycle.  Conventional commit using `fix(scope): Description goes here in sentence case`.  Choose: `fix`, `chore`, `feat`.  Project uses semantic versioning; feat will trigger a minor version increment.

pullRequest.instructions: PR body is focused, terse.  3-5 sentence prose summary of the changes; a few terse bullet points to call out key changes.
